Fixed-output converter; pin 1 VIN, 2 GND, 3 VOUT. Body 14 x 7.6 x 10.2 mm. Continuous short-circuit protection and automatic recovery; typical output current limit is 360% of rated output for this 5 V model. Maximum stated capacitive load is 820 uF. Verify all downstream capacitance, WT32/MG90S transients and enclosed temperature.
Fixed 5 V 2 A non-isolated switching regulator, 6.5-36 V input, SIP-3 THT
Keep for DigiKey build. Pin 1 sleeve; pins 2 and 3 both tip. PJ-210B is not a drop-in replacement. Check physical lead/slot fit.
2.5 mm mono probe jack, right-angle THT
Existing provisional pad geometry retained. Exact manufacturer drawing and sample fit remain release gates. Not an Ethernet/magnetics jack.
Carrier side only. J1 receives 12 V from the PD module and feeds K1 normally closed contact (PD_12V); J7 is 3.3 V DEBUG. Same mate fits both: label/key harnesses and never interchange.

NC to PD_12V, NO to WALL_12V, COM to +12V. Coil directly across raw WALL_12V/GND with D3 flyback. One input selected at a time; wall has priority. NC rated 3 A/30 VDC, NO 5 A/30 VDC. Coil 360 ohm, 33.3 mA, 0.4 W at 12 V; use SPDT G5Q-1, not SPST G5Q-1A. Body maximum 20.3 x 10.3 x 15.8 mm housing plus 0.4 mm molded feet; reserve 16.2 mm seated height. Switchover may restart controller; no brownout supervisor. https://components.omron.com/eu-en/system/files/2026-04/datasheet_pdf/J155-E1.pdf
12 V coil SPDT changeover relay; automatic wall-priority power selection

Pin 1/A is raw WALL_12V and feeds K1 coil and normally open contact; pin 2/B is GND; pin 3/C is unused. The NC jack switch joins B-C, not the center contact. K1 selects wall power when energized, PD otherwise. Face offset from pin A is 13.6 mm; housing 9 x 10.8 mm, bore axis 6.5 mm above PCB.
5.5 x 2.1 mm center-positive barrel inlet; sleeve NC contact unused
Carrier end of WT32 EXT harness; not the WT32's 1.25 mm connector. Pin 8 unused.
Socket only; ADC already owned. Confirm module pitch, edge offsets, insertion height and insulating support.
Shunt ordered separately; remove shunt before powering WT32 from programming USB.
14 mm maximum seated height. 630 mA ripple at 10 kHz; verify actual input ripple and heating.
470 uF 35 V, 105 C radial, D10 / P5
Replaces C3 220 uF plus C5 100 uF with one 470 uF part. 13 mm maximum seated height; remains below U2's 820 uF stated maximum capacitive load before downstream capacitance is counted.
470 uF 16 V, low-impedance 105 C radial, D8 / P3.5
4 x 2.5 mm body, 5.5 mm maximum seated height and 5 mm formed-lead pitch. Carrier-level ADC-rail bypass C13 is removed because the socketed module must provide local bypassing.
100 nF 50 V X7R 10%, radial MLCC, P5
D2 blower flyback: banded cathode FAN_OUT, anode GND. D3 relay-coil flyback: banded cathode raw WALL_12V, anode GND. D3 slows relay release; check supply switchover on the actual assembly.

Mount horizontally, tab down, using the formed-lead footprint. Pin 1 gate, 2 drain, 3 source; tab is live FAN_OUT. Reserve 6.5 mm height including 1 mm insulating support and forming tolerance. Retain with insulating support and side adhesive fillets, no tab bolt. Support leads during forming; verify sample fit and enclosed temperature at 100 Hz fan PWM.
Blower gate-driver transistor only. Form leads carefully to the wide-pitch THT footprint; do not reverse E/C.
Direct 3.3 V GPIO drive through R6 at 4 kHz; pin 2 to ground. 7.8 mm maximum seated height. Confirm useful audibility in the enclosure.
Passive piezo transducer, 3 V rated, 4 kHz, D12.2 / P5
R1 dissipates about 0.144 W at continuous fan-on. Buy ten for $0.42, less than five for $0.50.
Blower transistor base resistor; 6.3 x 2.4 mm body and 7.62 mm formed lead pitch.
Direct-drive piezo series resistor. Limits the ideal initial 3.3 V capacitive-step current to 10 mA; 6.3 x 2.4 mm body and 7.62 mm formed lead pitch. Price checked 2026-09-05.

R5 is the servo pull-down; R10-R12 are probe bias resistors. Using common 1% parts trades roughly 0.2-0.5 C worst-case bias error across typical cooking temperatures for a large prototype cost reduction; calibrate each probe channel.

Support the socketed ADS1115 free edge and retain it for transport. Verify actual socket seating and underside protrusions. No guessed module mounting holes.
Confirm exact WT32 connector and mating cable. JST-XH BOM parts are only the carrier ends of these harnesses.

12 V wall adapter and barrel plug

Use only a protected/current-limited regulated 12 V adapter rated no more than 3 A with a 5.5 × 2.1 mm center-positive plug. K1 automatically gives powered wall input priority over USB-PD. No internal adjustment. Transfer may restart the controller; verify contact inrush and adapter brownout.

Measure startup/loaded motion and combined RJ45 return current. This revision intentionally has no onboard fuses or branch-selective overcurrent protection. Do not connect carrier RJ45 to Ethernet equipment.
PIT, MEAT 1, MEAT 2. Verify calibration and firmware excitation-reference equation before thermal testing.
